description: Book a call with the INITE team for a named person, with their consent and their own email. starts_at must be a slot from inite_slots; topic is a service id from inite_services (default: diagnostic). They get a calendar invite; the answer's booking_key moves (inite_move_call) or cancels (inite_cancel_call) it. Terms: free, no deposit, no fee to cancel or for a no-show; move up to 3 times, cancel any time before it starts.

company.description: Their company or site, if they gave one

email.description: The person's own email; the confirmation and the calendar invite go there

lang.description: The reader's language; sets the currency (pt quotes reais) and the copy. Default en.

message.description: What they want to talk about

name.description: The person's name, as they want to be addressed

time_zone.description: IANA zone for the confirmation email

topic.description: The service the call is about, an id from inite_services (default: diagnostic)

name: inite_book_call
title: Book a call with INITE
